factoryUn.description:
{Factory}

The Factory towns are towns of the Forge dissenters mostly. Led by former Kastore's commander Urabrask and the former de-facto leader of the Project Outpost known as Von Frederich, these artificers and freethinkers are scattered all around the Jadame. The de-facto capital of the Factory forces is the town named Burton. The Factory's army are made from the locals and the dissenters armed with deadly combination of old and new tech. Due to abundance of renegades and freethinkers, Factory's territory is an almost lawless place, guarded by Gunslingers and Rogues along.
